mechanisms.detail: Fourteen-segment discovery (Munich / Arabellapark / Bogenhausen territory; German primary, English control). Live reuses existing artifacts — none exist for this hotel.
CAD classification + PLP embedded in discovery; classification only.
Standard stage, mock_live only ($0). Low weight for an urban meetings/congress hotel; enabled so the unified path is exercised.
Reuses settled queue dossiers; missing → HOLD.
Existing Exa agent adapter, Checkpoint A pattern; requires authorization id + ceiling + manifest + GDI_EXA_AGENT_LIVE=1.
Public-first named-contact channels; Findymail only when authorized (FINDYMAIL_API_KEY).
Strict FQO + entry-point reachability + buying-authority annotation (in memory).
Package build + validation; STAGED activation only if founder includes it in the GO. CURRENT never changes.

airtableWriteScope.ifSeparatelyAuthorized: Group Demand Opportunities upsert for hotelId recFaxTEFF9ILHWC9 only (idempotent, dry-run first via -PlanResearchPersistence), exact write-set text required, GDI_RESEARCH_INVENTORY_PRODUCTION_WRITES=1. No schema changes, no other hotels, no CURRENT.

prerequisitesAndRisks: BLOCKING: Live Stage 1/2 reuse existing discovery + deep-research artifacts. None exist for this hotel, so Live would HOLD at Stage 1 until a discovery matrix exists in -OutDir (fourteen-segment-discovery-matrix.json). Producing it uses SerpApi via the original research chain and is NOT covered by the Exa/Findymail limits — needs a separate founder decision.
A tranche manifest (01-TRANCHE_MANIFEST.json) must be authored for this hotel; no Wyndham manifest may be reused.
Findymail credit hard cap: pass -FindymailCreditHardCap 15 (--findymail-credit-hard-cap 15); Stage 4 shared budget stops enrichment at CREDIT_HARD_CAP_REACHED.
Flag names above follow the Live orchestrator CLI at the time of writing; re-run the pre-live gate before GO.

authorizationToken.note: Proposed identifier only. It authorizes nothing until the founder issues it in writing.

pwsh -File scripts/gdi/Invoke-GdiFullE2E.ps1 -HotelId recFaxTEFF9ILHWC9 -Mode Live -AuthorizePaidResearch `
  -AuthorizationId 'FOUNDER_GO_GDI_LIVE_E2E_WESTIN_MUNICH_20261128' -HardCeilingUsd 25 `
  -Manifest 'reports/gdi-fresh-hotel-live-e2e-recFaxTEFF9ILHWC9-20261128/01-TRANCHE_MANIFEST.json' -OutDir 'reports/gdi-fresh-hotel-live-e2e-recFaxTEFF9ILHWC9-20261128' `
